summary.text: Jeion Ward is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 87, which covers part of the City of Hampton.
Jeion Ward has been a member since 2004.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Jeion Ward was born in Newport News, Virginia, in 1954.
Jeion Ward studied at Christopher Newport University (B.A., 1995) and Thomas Nelson Community College.
Jeion Ward's listed occupation is middle school teacher.

Jeion Ward's listed memberships and affiliations include the NAACP, the National Council of Negro Women, the Peninsula Central Labor Council, the Democratic Women's Club, the Hampton Federation of Teachers (president), the Coalition of Labor Union Women, the Virginia AFL-CIO (executive council), and Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. (Hampton Alumnae Chapter).
The profile lists James Addrill Ward, Sr. as Jeion Ward's spouse.
The House profile lists Jeion Ward's committee assignments as Labor and Commerce (Chair), Transportation, Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Rules.
